lead: The options show one verb in several forms: base, to + verb, -ing, -ed. The word before the blank decides which form is allowed, and some to words are prepositions.
選項是同一個動詞的幾種形式：原形、to + 動詞、-ing、-ed。空格前面的字決定可以用哪一種，而且有些 to 是介系詞。
steps: Find the word before the blank: a verb, an adjective, or a phrase ending in to.
找出空格前面的字：動詞、形容詞，或以 to 結尾的片語。
If the phrase ends in to, test a noun after it. If a noun fits, to is a preposition and -ing follows.
片語若以 to 結尾，就在後面放名詞試試。名詞放得進去，to 就是介系詞，後面接 -ing。
Otherwise, use the pattern that verb takes: -ing, to + verb, or object + to + verb.
否則就用該動詞的固定句型：-ing、to + 動詞，或受詞 + to + 動詞。

head: Phrases where to is a preposition
to 是介系詞的片語
body: look forward to, be committed to, be used to, in addition to, contribute to, object to. A noun fits after to, so use a noun or -ing, never a base verb.
look forward to、be committed to、be used to、in addition to、contribute to、object to。to 後面放得進名詞，所以接名詞或 -ing，不能接原形動詞。
ex: We look forward to hearing from you.
期待您的回覆。
The firm is committed to reducing its carbon emissions.
公司致力於減少碳排放。
Mr. Grant is used to working night shifts.
Grant 先生已經習慣上夜班。

head: Verb + -ing
動詞加 -ing
body: consider, avoid, suggest, recommend, finish, postpone, delay, mind, enjoy, include, involve, keep are followed by -ing, not by to + verb.
ex: The manager suggested postponing the product launch.
經理建議延後產品上市。
We are considering opening a new branch in Taichung.
我們正在考慮在台中開新分店。

head: Verb + to + verb
動詞加 to + 動詞
body: plan, decide, agree, hope, expect, intend, offer, refuse, fail, afford, hesitate are followed by to + base verb.
ex: Please do not hesitate to contact us.
請隨時與我們聯絡。
The company decided to hire two more designers.
公司決定再聘請兩位設計師。

head: Verb + object + to + verb
動詞加受詞加 to + 動詞
body: allow, enable, encourage, require, ask, remind, invite, urge, advise, permit take an object, then to + base verb. The passive keeps to: be allowed to.
allow、enable、encourage、require、ask、remind、invite、urge、advise、permit 先接受詞，再接 to + 原形動詞。被動時 to 保留：be allowed to。
ex: The new app enables customers to track their orders.
新的 App 讓顧客可以追蹤訂單。
All staff are required to complete safety training.
所有員工都必須完成安全訓練。

head: make, let, have, help, get
make、let、have、help、get 的用法
body: make, let, have + object + base verb. help + object takes a base verb or to + verb. get + object takes to + verb.
make、let、have + 受詞 + 原形動詞。help + 受詞之後，接原形或 to + 動詞都可以。get + 受詞 + to + 動詞。
ex: The director had her assistant book the flights.
主任請她的助理訂機票。
This guide will help you set up the device.
這份指南會幫助你設定這台裝置。
The manager got the technician to repair the printer before noon.
經理請技術人員在中午前修好印表機。

head: Adjective or noun + to + verb
形容詞或名詞加 to + 動詞
body: be able to, be likely to, be pleased to, be reluctant to, be eligible to; the ability to, an effort to, the opportunity to take a base verb. eligible for takes a noun.
be able to、be likely to、be pleased to、be reluctant to、be eligible to；the ability to、an effort to、the opportunity to 後面接原形動詞。eligible for 則接名詞。
ex: We are pleased to announce the opening of our new office.
我們很高興宣布新辦公室開幕。
Only full-time employees are eligible for the program.
只有全職員工有資格參加這個計畫。
Employees with one year of service are eligible to apply.
服務滿一年的員工有資格申請。

pairs.right: I look forward to meeting you.
pairs.wrong: I look forward to meet you.
why: The to in look forward to is a preposition, so -ing follows.
look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 -ing。

pairs.right: The consultant suggested hiring more staff.
pairs.wrong: The consultant suggested to hire more staff.
why: suggest takes -ing or a that-clause, never to + verb.
suggest 後面接 -ing 或 that 子句，不接 to + 動詞。

pairs.right: He used to work in sales.
pairs.wrong: He is used to work in sales.
why: used to + base verb is a past habit. be used to + -ing means 'accustomed to'.
used to 加原形表示過去曾經。be used to 加 -ing 表示習慣於。

traps: Seeing to before the blank does not mean a base verb follows. Test with a noun: look forward to the meeting works, so -ing follows.
看到空格前有 to，不代表後面接原形動詞。用名詞測試：look forward to the meeting 說得通，所以後面接 -ing。
stop, forget, try change meaning with the form. stop to check means pause in order to check; stop checking means quit checking.
stop、forget、try 接不同形式，意思不同。stop to check 是停下來去檢查；stop checking 是不再檢查。
recommend and suggest take -ing or a that-clause. The verb in that clause is in the base form.
recommend 和 suggest 後面接 -ing 或 that 子句。that 子句裡的動詞用原形。
